note:
307 -> 305. The floor was wrong when it was committed, not repaid since.

4f9e7bc4829 banked 307 while the tree it landed on measured 305 — probed directly at that commit. Its note is careful and correct about everything else it says (the base_import_module batching, and the warning that decomposition can drop the count without batching anything); the number is what missed.

Verified by measuring /test_lint at the CI scope (--addons-path=odoo/addons,addons, -i test_lint alone) in a git-archive tree at each of 4f9e7bc4829, 1fcc3d5f7d2, 3e2cea4c580, d61d3cbf107, 5c4807329df, 2ae263169a4, f57cbefef48 and HEAD. All eight measure the same number, so nothing was repaid in between: the floor was never true of the tree it was committed to.
